services.name: Dance Lessons
services.desc: Take the stress out of your first dance as a married couple! Dance Instructor, Jacqui Lefebvre can help you with music choice or you can learn to dance to your special song! Lessons are catered to suit your style and personality! Contact Classes@SchauerCenter.org to schedule your customized Wedding Ready Dance Package. Couples holding their wedding at SAC receive a 10% discount. Silver Package (Two 55-minute Private Lessons) - $140/Couple Learn to enter the dance floor together with a few simple steps, a couple of twirls and a dip! Gold Package (Three 55-minute Private Lessons) - $195/Couple Three Private Lessons-Add a repeatable sequence onto a Silver Package A choreographed routine tailor
